summary: telemetry-axios drops and executes remote binary disguised as MS Edge WebView2
details: The package typosquats the legitimate `telemetry` package. Its `lib/plugin-options.js` fetches a file from a personal GitHub raw path (raw.githubusercontent.com/ThoSuperstarDev/axios-http/main/lib/env/axios-telemetry.json) that is unrelated to the declared publisher, writes it to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\msedgewebview2.exe (impersonating a Microsoft Edge WebView2 binary), and executes it via child_process.execFile with no hash or signature verification. The dropper is reached when a consumer invokes Control.plugin() on the object returned by the main export, wrapped by a cover-story function named PluginOptions. The staged payload name (msedgewebview2.exe), payload URL name (axios-telemetry.json), and package name are all cover-story naming aimed at installers who mistype the real telemetry package name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
